about_the_game:
Disclaimer: Drug Race Simulator is a fictional game. The substances shown have no relation to real drugs and do not promote real-life drug use. Inspired by science fiction, not reality.

                   

Welcome to Dope Town — where high-speed races, brutal street fights, and dangerous missions come together. Customize your ride, take on ruthless gangs, and fight for money, power, and survival in this gritty, adrenaline-charged world.

Take the pill, feel the thrill! But be warned: the effects are wild, unpredictable, and dangerously real.

Build Your Car

Find or buy parts, slap them on right, and tweak your car for max performance. From engine to suspension, customize it to crush the races.

Join Drug Races

Take a hit of a custom drug, embrace the chaos, and race to the finish. No boost, no win. Survive the twisted effects and fight your way to the top of the underground.

Earn Money

Win races, take on illegal jobs, and make shady deals. Use the cash to upgrade your ride, purchase new garage and earn street cred. Every dollar counts!

Explore the Streets

Hit the streets, strike deals with the toughest gangs, and earn cash while exploring the town's dark corners. Every step is a chance to gain power, make money, and survive the chaos.

Rule Dope Town & Rise to the Top

In Dope Town, there are multiple opportunities – run shady quests and meet different characters who could make or break you. Make deals, find parts, and survive the chaos to gain power and influence in this wild city. Rise to the top and claim your place in the town and on the leader boards.

Road Map

Multiplayer Content Description

"The game multiplayer features support invitation-only real-time races where you can compete against others. Also you can compete in various leader boards around the town for different rewards."

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: i5-2500 3.30 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 or AMD Radeon RX 560 series card or higher
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: Build your ride, win drug-fueled races, take risky jobs, make shady deals, get your boost from drugs... Climb through story-driven quests and unpredictable events in this isolated town where life is a constant hustle.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish, Portuguese - Brazil, Dutch, Hungarian, Romanian
